types.comment: AI character base; size 0x140 from scalar_deleting_destructor 1c640 FastFree. Vptr first on Xbox, last (+0x140) on PS2: fields shift +0x10 up to +0xb8 (PS2 +0xa8), bools pack at +0xbc/+0xbd, then 0 from customTarget +0xc0, -4 at avoidZoneDistance +0x120, 0 again at avoidZoneBase +0x130. PS2 size 0x150.
